heading: Registering backends
text:
## Registering backends [NSBK.2]

**Every series backend is supplied by libds, and an integrator supplies and
registers none.** The seven backends of [NSBK.6.1] are compiled into `libds.a`,
and libds registers all of them when it constructs an engine — no path, no
`dlopen`, on every target libds runs on (including those without `dlopen`, e.g.
Xtensa/esp32). The public surface has no registration call.

A registration failure is a construction failure: libds must not return an
engine whose backends did not all register, and must return the registration
error instead. A `.dsc` series atom whose backing no registered backend serves
is refused with `DS_ERR_BACKEND_NOT_REGISTERED`, not silently degraded.

How libds shapes and checks its backends is the impl tree's
([ISBK.1], [ISBK.3]).
